Lanolin Farm-A bout Us

Lanolin Farm is home to two different breeds of sheep, each known for its unique
characteristics. The first breed grows short, white wool that feels very soft. The
other breed grows gray wool that is long and coarse. We shear the sheep twice a
year to collect the wool.

Wool can be purchased from our farm store either as raw material or as yarn that
we process on-site. The yarn can be used to make sweaters, hats, or blankets. We
offer several colors of dyed wool as well as undyed wool that retains its natural
color.
